full_judgment: 57. The High Court Division erred in law shifting the burden of proof upon the defence which would not at all be acceptable. We have discussed the evidence. It is proved that testimonies of prosecution witnesses are full of contradiction, surmise and conjecture, so far it appears in respect of condemned prisoner appellant.
